description:
Most B2B teams don't have a lead problem. They have a leak problem: the invites go out, a few people sign up, and nobody can say how many became sales calls.

This group is where I fix that in public. I'm Adi, founder of Tantra (formerly GrowthClub). My team has built funnels and outreach for 400+ brands in 47+ industries across 21+ countries, over 10+ years.

What you get here:
→ The weekly live webinar, {{when}}: I take a working B2B funnel apart in {{minutes}} minutes
→ Breakdowns of real outreach: calendar invites, cold email and LinkedIn
→ The reminders and follow-ups that turn sign-ups into booked sales calls
→ Straight answers when you post your own numbers

Want to run it yourself? Start at usetantra.com

Save your seat for this week's session: https://webinar.sellwithtantra.com
